answer: Sybil resistance arises because each identity is bonded to an escrow, while coordinated equivocation exposes the entire cluster: penalties scale as O(k^2) for k colluding identities, so adding agents creates a quadratic liability ripple rather than linear protection. Once detection links the swarm, asymmetric depreciation and an exponential multiplier amplify capital loss, turning every apparent sybil into a costly pearl of evidence and leaving the attack pattern a relic.
